items.title: Narrative acceleration: ai
items.thesis: AI capex narrative remains dominant, but concentration risk can trigger abrupt factor reversals if guidance softens.
invalidation_triggers: Two sequential capex guidance downgrades from top hyperscalers
Semiconductor backlog contraction with margin compression
retail_execution: Barbell: quality mega-cap ETF + defined-risk downside hedge
Avoid over-concentrated single-name exposure into earnings clusters

items.title: Narrative acceleration: eu
items.thesis: EU policy cohesion is overstated; fiscal-energy divergence can drive cross-country equity and FX dispersion.
invalidation_triggers: Coordinated fiscal package with stable forward energy curve
Spread compression sustained across peripheral sovereigns
retail_execution: Favor selective country/sector ETFs over broad regional beta
Keep EUR exposure hedged during policy event windows

items.title: Narrative acceleration: china
items.thesis: China stimulus signaling improves sentiment, but weak private demand still caps cyclical follow-through.
invalidation_triggers: PMI + credit impulse confirm broad domestic demand recovery
Property stress indicators stabilize across releases
retail_execution: Trade cyclicals tactically, not structurally
Watch EM/commodity proxies for confirmation before sizing up

items.title: Narrative acceleration: oil
items.thesis: Energy corridor fragility keeps upside oil risk underpriced versus consensus disinflation narratives.
invalidation_triggers: Sustained shipping normalization + inventory rebuild for 2 cycles
Verified geopolitical de-escalation across key routes
retail_execution: Pair energy exposure with transport/consumer hedge

items.title: Narrative acceleration: inflation
items.thesis: Disinflation narrative is vulnerable to energy and services stickiness; terminal-rate certainty is overestimated.
invalidation_triggers: Core/services inflation cools sequentially for 3 prints
Wage growth decelerates without growth shock
retail_execution: Blend inflation-sensitive and quality defensives
Avoid one-sided rate-cut consensus positioning

items.title: Narrative acceleration: rates

invalidation_triggers: Consistent policy communication + soft inflation sequence
MOVE volatility regime downshift over multiple sessions
retail_execution: Prioritize defined-risk options around macro prints
Reduce duration-sensitive concentration ahead of policy events
